title: Event (trigger → conditions → actions)
description: Native interactivity, like Storyline triggers or RPG Maker events: when something happens (on), if every condition holds (if), run the actions (do), otherwise run else. Prefer events over code in free objects.

description.description: One sentence for reviewers: what this event does and why.

do.description: Empty while the event is being written: it does nothing until it has an action (W_EVENT_NO_ACTION when else has none either).

type.description: screen.enter: the screen is shown. click: the learner uses a control of a block (target): a button block, or a button, tab or disclosure of a component, optionally filtered by its name. quiz.submitted: a quiz (target) is submitted, optionally filtered by result. decision.selected: an option of a decision block (target) is chosen, optionally filtered by option. object.event: a free object block (target) emits a declared event (name), optionally filtered by payload values (where). variable.changed: a variable changes. layer.closed: a layer (target) is closed. timeline.reached: playback of the screen's timeline crosses a moment (at): a line or a word starts or ends, seconds pass on a screen without narration; never on a seek, again when the learner replays the passage. timeline.ended: playback reaches the end of the narration. media.ended: an audio or video block (target) plays to its end.

target.description: Block or layer id the trigger listens to.

name.description: click: name of the control in the component template (data-t-click="name", data-t-tab="name" or data-t-toggle="name"); without it, any control of the block. object.event: event name, as declared in the free object's manifest.

where.description: Payload filter: every listed field must equal the given value.

at.description: timeline.reached: the moment playback crosses (a line, a word, seconds on a screen without narration).

cue.description: A moment of the screen's timeline (an anchor): a line, a word of a line, the end of either with an offset; seconds from the start of a step on a screen without narration; the start or end of a step.

condition.description: A variable compared with a value ({ variable, op, value }), or the visited state of a block's controls ({ visited, name }).

visited.description: Block id (any screen): holds once the learner has used every control of the block (its buttons, tabs and disclosures; a tab or disclosure counts once its content is shown), or only the control name. Saved with the learner's progress.

name.description: With visited: one control of the block, by name.

type.description: go-to: navigate (screen id, or next / previous). show-layer / hide-layer: open or close a layer of the current screen; hide-layer without layer closes the layer open on top (a Close button inside a layer). show-block / hide-block: change visibility of a block. reveal-step: reveal the steps of the screen up to step (a click in the slide instead of Continue); a step already shown takes the focus again. set-variable: assign a value. increment-variable: add a number (by, may be negative). complete-screen: mark the current screen complete. set-object-props: change declared props of a free object block without regenerating code. exit-course: save and leave (same as the Quit button). pause-timeline / play-timeline: pause the narration of the screen, or play it from where it is (a modal layer pauses and resumes it by itself). seek-timeline: move the timeline to a moment (to), as a seek: what is seen follows, nothing crossed fires, playback goes on if it was playing; a moment in a later step reaches that step. play-media / pause-media: play or pause an audio or video block (block) of the screen; playing one pauses the narration.

layer.description: show-layer, hide-layer: a layer of the current screen. Required by show-layer; hide-layer without it closes the open layer (the one on top).

step.description: reveal-step: a step of the blocks of this screen.

to.description: seek-timeline: the moment to go to.
